avis.texte: I have been using this product for several months and I absolutely love it. It does exactly what it says, while keeping my face moisturized. I still have half a bottle after all these months. The fragrance was an adjustment at first, but now it dosent bother my in the slightest.

avis.titre: I would buy it again as a special treat to me
avis.texte: I used this serum years ago and I liked it. I treated myself to something special and I'm enjoying the results. I only wish I had the coupon when I purchased it. Also I think that some freebies would have been nice. I wish more Ulta's sold this product.

The batch number on this purchase showed a manufacturing date that was 15 months old. That's basically expired even though they say the shelf life is 2 years for a serum. I'm not paying this much for an old product. Returned. But the serum is amazing

avis.titre: Holy grail serum but bad redesign
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for more than three years now. The new serum is runnier than the old version but it doesn't make much difference in terms of performance and properties. I'm disappointed with the new packaging though. The lid wouldn't close properly, and the body looks tacky and futuristic but in a bad way compared to the old version.
I would definitely keep buying this product. I feel that it shows visible results after using it just a few times. Love it!

avis.titre: I been using this product for over a year! Love it ❤️
avis.texte: I am very satisfied with my skin tone and my forehead wrinkles I am almost 50 years old and my skin feel like in my 30's also, I have oily skin but, it does not effect my skin it looks very glowing, pampered soft skin it also smells very nice 😊 I will totally 💯 recommend to anyone.

avis.titre: My skin is now 10 years younger
avis.texte: Absolutely worth every penny! This serum works wonders. My skin is brighter, plumper, hydrated, and all around rejuvenated and healthy. Feels almost 10 years younger! I love this serum. It blows all others out of the water and is the best, hands down. Buy it, you will love your results

**A Glowing Review: Dior Capture Le Sérum** I've been using Dior Capture Le Sérum for a few weeks now, and I can honestly say it's one of the best skincare products I've tried. The texture is incredibly lightweight and silky—it's almost like it melts into the skin upon application. There's no heavy or greasy residue, just a smooth, fresh feeling that lasts all day. What I love most is how it instantly makes my skin feel more hydrated and plump. Over time, I've noticed my skin looking more radiant and even-toned, with a healthy glow that wasn't there before. It also layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup, making it a great addition to both morning and evening routines. If you're looking for a serum that feels luxurious, absorbs effortlessly, and truly improves your skin's texture and tone, **Dior Capture Le Sérum** is definitely worth the splurge. It's gentle, effective, and makes your skin feel pampered and renewed.

the texture is divine, silky smooth but quickly absorbed. After a week of using the serum, definitely helped my skin feel more firm and plump. The serum has a gorgeous signature scent that smells luxurious, is not overpowering, and does not irritate my skin. The Dior Capture Ox-C Treatment Day Cream is thick and it comes with a tiny spoon to scoop. I love how luxurious and gorgeous the Le Serum bottle is made, a heavy metallic glass. The application of both products feels like I'm treating myself to a facial.

I really enjoyed using the Dior Capture Le Sérum. It's lightweight, sinks in quickly, and leaves my skin feeling noticeably smoother and more radiant. After a few uses, my complexion looked more refreshed and plump, which I loved. However, I did notice a bit of redness after application. It wasn't painful or lasting, just some mild irritation that faded after a while. If you have sensitive skin like me, it might be worth doing a patch test first. Overall, a lovely serum with visible results, but I'd recommend it more for those without reactive skin.

After awhile I noticed my face appeared smoother and brighter and that's when I realized it was the serum. I do wish it didn't have the scent however. It smells nice, but fragrance isn't good for acne prone skin.

This serum smells divine. It's a lightweight texture that absorbs flawlessly. I will note that I have sensitive skin and was not able to use this consistently on my face without mild irritation - so I primarily use on my neck instead, but for a neck serum it definitely holds its own

Dior Capture Totale Le Sérum is a luxurious anti-aging serum designed to firm, smooth, and hydrate the skin. It has a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. Infused with Dior's patented Bio-Cellular Technology and Longoza flower extract, the serum helps improve skin elasticity and radiance over time. After consistent use, skin appears more plumped and refined, with a noticeable glow. While the serum is on the pricier side, its high-quality ingredients and visible results make it a worthwhile investment for those looking to enhance their skincare routine. Ideal for all skin types, especially those seeking anti-aging benefits.

Such a good product… very smooth on your skin.. very clean smell not a perfume smell… makes your skin feel really nice .., I will be buying this again and I will also be getting some for my mom since she stole mine and started using it also hahaha

I love the texture of this and that it doesn't love your skin sticky. The scent is very strong at first but fades and reminds me of baby powder. I couldn't use this on my face as it's very sensitive so I used it on my neck. I could feel the instant tensing effect that Dior mentions on their packaging. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: i would buy this product agian
avis.texte: Very excited to use new products from Dior. Dior is a world-famous brand so I always trust and love them. With the serum and cream set, it has brought me brighter skin. The brown spots and dull skin, with aging wrinkles of the 34-year-old are now completely different thanks to the nourishing cream set from Dior. I will follow it and support it

Dior Capture Le Serum Ox-C treatment is a lovely product. It has the signature fragrance for this skincare line. The serum's texture is light but concentrated, smoothes on easily with no pulling, and absorbs quickly. The Ox-C component means that skin tightening and brightening results happen simultaneously with application and are longer lasting with consistent use. I haven't experienced any breakouts, rash, or other irritation while using all the products from this line. It's perfection. My skin is tighter, smoother, softer, brighter, and more even toned. This serum used in conjunction with the day creme provides the perfect background for all my makeup looks from no-makeup makeup to full dramatic ott. No pilling, sliding, or changing colors. It's light enough for humid hot summer and heavy enough to combat winter dryness. There is no situation where I want to be without this product. I was gifted this by Dior in exchange for review but my provided opinion is unbiased.

The Dior Capture Totale Le Sérum has been a game-changer for my skin! As a woman in my 40s, I'm always looking for something that hydrates, firms, and brings back that youthful glow—and this serum does it all. The texture is silky and lightweight, absorbing quickly without feeling sticky. After just a few weeks, my skin feels smoother, plumper, and more radiant. It gives me that fresh, well-rested look, even on busy days. Plus, the packaging is beautiful, making it a little luxury in my daily routine. Definitely a must-try if you want your skin to feel refreshed and revitalized!

Love the packaging! Texture is luxurious and the scent is nothing to worry about! Ok I don't know about long term changes because I think we are all tainted with social media filters and expectations so I can't go there... But as far as a daily glow up oh my! It's an instant picker upper. The change my face shows as soon as I put both the cream and serum is drastic. Back to life! I have been using these products for over a month daily. Still have a bunch left since a little goes a long way. I am loving these!!!!
After using just once my skin felt very hydrated and smooth. And after a week it was noticeably more plump and radiant. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

This is a nice serum. It absorbs quickly and adds moisture without being greasy. I do think it provides some firming. The packaging is beautiful and it does have a light scent, but it's not overpowering. Overall very nice! It pairs well with the corresponding face cream. I did receive this product in exchange for my honest opinion.

This stuff is amazing! It's expensive but well worth it and lasts a super long time. I've been using it for about a month and already see a HUGE difference in the appearance of my skin- less fine lines and very smooth. I received this product for free to review. I'm in LOVE and will continue to use.

Absolutely loved the serum. So geateful.to get this product to try! The texture is smooth and velvety and absorbs into my skin well. Does not really have a smell and the packaging is super bougie in it's silver bottle. Loved the ingredients too and hopefully see some changes with longer use. It is very expensive so would have to use it longer to decide whether I would purchase at full price though.

This serum has a luxury packaging. It has a light scent with a lightweight texture that helps it absorb into your skin easily. My skin looks more hydrated, brightened, and smother than before. In addition, I have sensitive skin. My skin isn't irritated after using it. Highly recommended.

I was really excited to get these! One half of my face is much less firm and plump than the other, from a broken cheek bone, so it's something I miss about having my bone structure in tact haha. But I have used this for almost a month now and see no difference in my problem areas… if anything, it gave me a bit of acne. Maybe I used too much ? Texture of the day cream is really nice and feels good and hydrating to put on.

Being in my 40's, I am looking for skin products that will help with moisture, elasticity and texture. This product feels nice on aging mature male skin. My skin tends to feel very dry after spending a lot of time outside, this product brings that moisture back to the skin. It's a very light textured serum that melts into the skin, but the effects are visible. I'm not into highly scented products, but this one is nice and subtle. My wife wanted me to mention that she thinks the packaging brings elegance to the bathroom counter top. Apparently, that last point helps the ladies with their picks. I enjoy trying these products and finding what works for male skin.
I received this product as a part of a promotion. It is light and smoothes fine lines and wrinkles. The smell is not overpowering and it is a good base for foundation.
This serum is not over powering and light. It provides a good base for hydration. It smoothes wrinkles and softens fine lines.

I have been using the Dior Serum for a couple of weeks to ensure a fair review. For the price point I was expecting magic in a bottle. Although it didn't sweep me off my feet I did see some results. The thick creamy serum did moisturize my dry winter skin. I did notice smaller pores and plumper skin. I'm in my 30's and don't have defined wrinkles yet but did not notice much difference on the creases I have around my eyes. I do love that most of the ingredients are natural. There is a very light scent which isn't the best but not terrible either. The packaging is gorgeous and very sleek although it's irritating to see the finger prints on it after handling it. Overall I liked the serum just not something I would buy myself.

As neurotoxin user that is now pregnant, I was looking for a skin care product I could use while I was unable to get injections. Dior's Capture Le Serum has been just that! After checking to make sure all ingredients were pregnancy safe, I started to use it daily. What I saw was my skin texture improve and my fine lines start to be less noticeable. It's not as strong as a neurotoxin but it surely has been keeping my wrinkles from progressing and has helped to smooth fine lines! The packaging and bottle look luxe and the serum smells nice and clean with faint scent. The pump works well at giving just the exact amount of product needed. I would highly recommend this to other pregnant women looking for a good alternative or anyone that would like a neurotoxin alternative!

I was sent this facial serum for personal use in exchange for an honest review. The packaging was very nice and sleek. Scent was not noticeable in container or on. It has a thin creamy texture and was easy to spread. I did not notice any huge difference in the couple weeks I tried it. I don't have large wrinkles as it is, but face did not feel tighter or any different. Used with the moisturizing cream that came with it. No reactions during use.

Dior took it to the next level! This serum is deliciously perfect. It does what it claims, and that's only something you get with better brands. I'd rather spend more money on something that works and lasts forever (concentrated) than spend money on countless cheaper products. Product is extremely light and absorbs in to skin as if it was part of it. I am glowing g, getting compliments, and know that it will make me look younger the longer I use it. Complimentary.

The Dior Capture Le Serum is one of the best serums I have ever used! This product has a lot of ingredients but they are 97% natura-origin ingredients. It is a milky smooth serum that absorbs easily into the skin. It does not leave my face feeling greasy or oily. It does have a slight scent and I don't really care for it. I have seen a big difference in my wrinkles since starting this product and I love it.

This luxuary collagen activating serum is very nice. It has a faint fragrance that smells great. The texture melts right into your skin. I'm almost 34 and my under eyes look awesome with no makeup up because of this.

I received this product for free to review and for the retail price point, I guess I expected something more. While yes, it does work as a serum would and should, it didn't really do anything more than what my other serums do. It was also a little too perfume smelling to me. The packaging is beautiful but it was just alright for me.

Gifted product. I've been using this serum for the past 6 weeks and I really like it. It's feels luxurious and quickly absorbs into my skin. I use three pumps, which covers my face, neck and decollate. I'm surprised it's lasted me this long. Only bummer is I can't tell how much product is left in the container.

First, the packaging is so nice. The bottle looks elegant. The serum blends easily into the skin and absorbs quickly. It had a light floral fragrance, which is lovely. It seemed to really hydrate my skin. My skin looks and feels plumper while using this product. I received this product for free to review.

Dior capture Le Serum is my new favorite serum. It is so easy to use. For myself, I like to use 2 pumps. It glides on so smoothly. Leaves my face feeling moisturized. I have noticed a big difference in my face elasticity and smoothness. It has also helped tremendously in reducing my large pores. I love it.

avis.titre: Might be better on noticeably aged skin
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The Dior Capture serum is a lightweight product that applies smoothly and both absorbs and hydrates well. I stopped using a majority of my skincare products to test this out unbiased. Honestly, I don't see much improvement to my fine lines or my deep thought lines across my forehead, but overall my skin does feel more plump and I can both see and feel the difference throughout the day when the serum is applied. When I cleanse at night, I can see and feel the difference, both the product being removed, and the smoothness left behind, and I am left with a nice moisture barrier that makes nighttime skincare easy. One pump of serum covers the face entirely, but if you want to cover the neck/décolletage as well, you will need a second pump. The scent is clean, and I did not feel any irritation, even when applying around the eyes. The packaging is sleek with a luxury look and feel, but be careful picking up the serum by the cap as the bottle may drop due to its weight.

I've been using this serum for a few weeks now, and it has really changed my skin! My skin feels super moisturized, plump, and firm. This serum is so light and it absorbs well into my skin. It's helped me realize that it's not too early to start using products that encourage collagen production for wrinkles as a preventative. I'm only in my 30s, but the serum is already knocking out the bit of aging that I was starting to see on my face! If you're wondering whether or not you should try it, you should!

I don't know what kind of magic is in this serum but WOW my skin looks so good the morning after using this in my nighttime skincare routine. The first few times after using it I couldn't figure out why my skin looked so bright, clear and smooth. Then it clicked…it was the Dior serum. The packaging is beautiful and I really do feel like I've noticed a difference in my skin (as it should be for the price of this serum). There is a scent to this but it's very rich and pleasant and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

Such beautiful packaging so on brand for dior. I love how plump my skin feels after this. It definitely helps improve brightness although i do want to wait a little while longer to test it out properly i love what its done for my skin so far. It does have natural smells as all dior products do but i enjoy that. Its a bit more expensive than their other stuff but so far its worth it.

The packaging and aesthetic of this product is unique and modern, which I love. I used this product along with the Dior day crème for a few weeks and got compliments on my skin looking softer. The scent on the serum is minimal. The product is light and doesn't feel sticky or too thick or thin. Ingredients seem promising with its ox-c technology.

Absolutely love this face serum and day crème. They both go on so smoothly and weightless. I felt like I had absolutely nothing on after applying them. I noticed an improvement in all the things that it helps with. My face feels firmer. And it helped with wrinkles not be as noticeable. This is a must have. The bottles are so pretty and can tell that it's a quality product. The crème came with a little spatula to help get the product out without having to use your finger. I received this product for free for my honest review.

Dior Capture Le Sérum is a luxurious, fast-absorbing serum that improves skin texture, radiance, and hydration. After regular use, my skin feels plump, smooth, and looks more youthful. It's pricey, but the results make it worth the investment
Wow instantly your skin feels super hydrated and plumped helping fines lines to look diminished. Dior always has that rose scent, but disappears after a while. Clean ingredients and sleek packaging.

Dior Capture OX-C Treatment Le Sérum is a beautifully formulated brightening serum that gives your skin a fresh and revitalized glow. From the start of use, it provides a noticeable boost in hydration, leaving your complexion looking more radiant and awake. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly, making it easy to layer with other skincare or wear under makeup too. With its blend of Vitamin C and oxygenation technology, this serum works over time to improve clarity and even out skin tone. Regular use leaves skin feeling smoother and looking healthier, with a natural luminosity. The sleek, elegant packaging adds to the luxurious experience, making it a joy to use every day. I highly recommend it!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. After two uses my skin started to break out. I stopped using it until my skin recovered. Used it again to make sure it wasn't a word one time thing and my skin broke out again. I don't have sensitive skin. Disappointed in such an expensive product.

This serum is absolutely a must try. I use many serums and this one just feels very silky and luxurious. My skin feels very plump without the heaviness of some other serums. Very happy with product. A must buy!

I was gifted this for a review. This is nice but: -it's more like a lotion than a serum -it has a strong fragrance. It faded away but still starts out as A LOT -holy schmoly the PRICE! I feel like I see way better results from Lancôme Génifique, which isn't cheap but per ounce is a bargain compared to this. If you've got cash to burn and super dry skin, maybe? But it wasn't magic for me and it pilled so it's my weekend face.

Classy packaging, felt like a little gift. The pictures don't reflect the difference the product made on my face very well. My skin feels tighter. It feels moisturized throughout the day without feeling greasy. There's certainly a moisture barrier doing it's job. I can tell the difference in my skin texture and how much better my makeup sits on my face. However, both the serum and the moisturizer do have a very strong scent so that's a bit off putting.

I am 44 years old with fine lines and dry skin. While this did help my dry skin, it did not hwlp my fine lines. I used it for a month. It has a light smell and felt nice on the skin. I recieved this free as a promotional product

My wife had this to say any the product. The serum has a luxurious design and is a beautiful product. I love the presentation, and it feels good going on my skin! I dont appreciate the use of perfume in the product. That being said, it is only lightly scented and is not a bad smell. Wearing the serum and cream together for only a week, I saw a noticeable difference in my skin. It was softer, plumper, and had more glow. We received this as a free sample to test and review.

I have really enjoyed the serum and face cream. The serum is lightweight and works well on sensitive skin, without clogging pores. The cream is thick which is great for winter- I also like the applicator it comes to scoop it out. The only downside is the strong floral scent of these products- if you are sensitive to smells then it may be a deterrent.

This serum is lightweight, instantly absorbs into the skin, and is hygienic due to the pump. The pump also helps maintain the formula's integrity. My skin had an instant velvet feel, without the sensation of any product being on my skin. I was also pleasantly surprised by the lack of perfume in the serum. A step in the right direction dior! I received this serum for free to review, but all opinions are my own.

I wish I liked this more than I did. I gave owned a previous version of this product (capture totale?) and was no more impressed with this version than the original (which was good already)! The texture and application are comfortable and pleasant as with most Dior products, but wear and effects -wise, wasn't anything breathtaking or impressive.

So far so good. I haven't really noticed a huge difference yet but I do see a more glowy look to my skin. I did have a little burning sensation when I applied the serum to my forehead. Overall a great product.

I am pleasantly suprised because Dior Capture Le Serum has improved greatly since the last time I used it. The new formula now has OX-C treatment. I am almost 39. It has very noticeably increased my skin's firmness. I could feel that it is much more powerful at first use. It has been a month and I can't imagine using anything else. My skin's elasticity and plumpness have increased. Plus, my fine lines are filled in and my deeper frown lines are significantly less noticeable. I have tried so many top of the line serums. This one knocked my top choice of the last 3 years off the throne. By a landslide. I can actually feel the serum working its magic. The scent is lovely. Dior Capture Le serum smells rich and clean. They have created something revolutionary in my opinion. I use the serum and day cream together and I think that has helped me see maximum results. I simply cannot go back to my old products after getting such amazing results. I am in love.

I've been using this product for about 3 weeks + my skin is glowing + feels absolutely amazing! This leaves my skin feeling so soft + glassy! I loved the packaging that it came in + love the bottle as well. I received this product as a gift in exchange for my review.

In love with this serum! You can feel the tightening almost as soon as you apply it and my skin looks and feels amazing. I've been using this for a couple of weeks and have seen an improvement in my fine lines on my forehead as well as my smile lines looking less defined. The packaging is gorgeous and luxe and is a beautiful mirror finish. It does attract fingerprints, but a quick wipe is all it takes to clean it. It does have a fragrance but I find it fades within 5-10 minutes. Highly recommend adding this to your routine!! I received this in exchange for my review.

Repurchasing. I've been using this product for 21 days and can say it has made a difference. My face is smoother, has a glow to it, and feels and looks more plump. I also see fewer wrinkles at the end of my eyes- where I had three lines when I smile, I now only see one. My husband has noticed a difference and mentioned my face looks more vibrant- he doesn't know I've incorporated this product into my daily routine. The product itself is lightweight, nonsticky, and spreads easily on the face. It also absorbs well and does not leave any tackiness. Worth every penny!

Dior has improved a lot since a few years ago ingredients wise. A lot cleaner than before. Therefore I would definitely recommend this serum. The scent is not strong but luxurious. Lightweight texture that absorbs nicely leaving skin soft and smooth.

Absolutely love Dior Capture Le Serum! My skin feels so hydrated, smooth, and radiant after using it. The texture is lightweight yet deeply nourishing, and it absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy. I've noticed a real difference in my skin's firmness and glow.

From the moment I opened the box, I was stunned by the beautiful packaging. The chrome bottle is very eye-catching sitting on my vanity. The product itself is very lightweight and hydrating without being too heavy or sticky feeling. It does have a light fragrance but it isn't anything crazy and it fades pretty quickly. Overall, I was very impressed by the results I've gotten from this serum. My skin is softer and more radiant. I will definitely continue to purchase in the future

avis.titre: I love this product- price point crazy
avis.texte: I waited to use the product for a couple of weeks since i wanted to make sure I gave it a fair review. The ingredients do not seem to irritate my already sensitive skin. It was a light creamy serum texture. It went on like a dream in my skin rotation. Very little scent, and had some shine. The price point throws me a little off, but if it continues working on me, I'll have to prioritize my budget. This item was given to me for my own personal review.

avis.titre: Great product ; would have to work through price point
avis.texte: I waited to use the product for a couple of weeks since i wanted to make sure I gave it a fair review. The ingredients do not seem to irritate my already sensitive skin. It was a light creamy serum texture. It went on like a dream in my skin rotation. Very little scent, and had some shine. The price point throws me a little off, but if it continues working on me, I'll have to prioritize my budget. This review was part of a promotional product.

Received product for free honest review. The Dior serum was a nice smooth texture. It was easy to apply and a nice light scent. It absorbed well and quickly. It seemed to make my skin more moisturized and works well with the Dior cream. The packaging is luxurious but does gets fingerprints. It is expensive though.

So, this package and container was very nicely done! There isn't a strong smell to it and I like that aspect. The serum is very smooth and goes on nicely. It absorbs well and I've overall seen a difference in my skin. My skin is brighter and very smooth. I was surprised to be honest.

So, this package and container was very nicely done! There isn't a strong smell to it and I like that aspect. The serum is very smooth and goes on nicely. It absorbs well and I've overall seen a difference in my skin. My skin is brighter and very smooth. I was surprised to be honest.

As someone in my early thirties focused on youthful skin, I recently tried Dior Capture Le Sérum and noticed positive results. It has visibly softened the fine lines around my forehead and eyes, leaving my skin smoother and more plump. I did experience an initial increase in breakouts, which was concerning, but my skin eventually adjusted. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and provides lasting benefits throughout the day. Overall, I recommend Dior Capture Le Sérum for anyone looking to enhance their skincare routine, as the reduction in fine lines and improved texture have made it a worthwhile addition for me!

A little goes a long way and it is definitely worth the hype. I am in my 30's and noticed my wrinkles softening. Great light weight serum that pairs well with sunscreen. I a stay at home mom and love how quick my skin care routine is with this amazing product!

I absolutely adore this serum when paired with the day cream! It feels incredibly luxurious on my skin. After using it for a few weeks, I've definitely noticed a reduction in the appearance of my fine lines and wrinkles. The packaging also exudes an expensive and heavy feel. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because of the scent of the day cream. It reminds me of an old lady's perfume lol unscented would make this even better.

Been using this product for about 2 weeks, I did notice a small improvement on my skin but not what I was expecting. Love the texture and scent but I need better results for this specific at this price point. Great packaging easy to open/close to use.

Love this product. It smells great, goes on smooth. The active ingredients must be strong because it was tingly in the beginning but my skin adjusted. Great product, great packaging. Would use it again.
A very luxurious and rich texture that sinks into the skin beauscent, it smells delightful! The packaging is also so beautiful.my skin felt deeply moisturized .

Lotion-like texture, lightweight and hydrating, with good spreadability and quick absorption. It doesn't feel sticky on the skin and is suitable for most skin types (including dry and combination skin). Oily skin may need to reduce follow-up skincare steps in summer to avoid heaviness. Pairs well with sunscreen during the day without pilling, but it's best used at night. The fragrance is mild and non-irritating.

Love this product! It smells amazing, feels amazing and my skin is looking great. The ingredients must be pretty potent because it tingled the first few times I used it, but my skin adjusted. Sophisticated packaging and look.

I received these products for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been using both Dior Capture Le Serum and Day Cream for about 3 weeks, I haven't noticed much results in reducing wrinkles yet but I really like these products. I applied every night before bed and noticed my skin is soft and plump every morning. I'm very sensitive with the fragrance skincare products but I don't have problems with these. They are light scented and is very settle on your skin after applied. The thick day cream is light weighted when applied on your skin. I also don't have any breakouts on my skin using it. The Dior Capture Ox-C Treatment Day Cream is thick and it comes with a tiny spoon to scoop. I love how luxurious and gorgeous the Le Serum bottle is made, a heavy metallic glass. I will give it more times to see the results but overall I would buy these products again for my daily skin care routine.

I've been using both Dior Capture Le Serum and Day Cream for about 3 weeks, I haven't noticed much results in reducing wrinkles yet but I really like these products. I applied every night before bed and noticed my skin is soft and plump every morning. I'm very sensitive with the fragrance skincare products but I don't have problems with these. They are light scented and is very settle on your skin after applied. The thick day cream is light weighted when applied on your skin. I also don't have any breakouts on my skin using it. The Dior Capture Ox-C Treatment Day Cream is thick and it comes with a tiny spoon to scoop. I love how luxurious and gorgeous the Le Serum bottle is made, a heavy metallic glass. I will give it more times to see the results but overall I would buy these products again for my daily skin care routine.

I received this product free from Dior in exchange for my honest review. This product works amazingly. I love the scent. It really did fill in my crows feet around my eyes and I love how it moisturizes my dry skin as well. I highly recommend this product!

For almost three weeks, I have been incorporating the Dior Capture Le Serum and Day Creme into my skincare regimen. In preparation for my wedding, I was eager to try this premium skincare line. I have applied the products daily, both morning and night, and I am impressed with their ability to instantly hydrate my skin. Unfortunately, I have not yet observed a noticeable reduction in wrinkles. The products have a clean, subtle fragrance and a non-greasy texture. The packaging is heavy and sophisticated. I plan to continue using these products, with the expectation that, given time, my skin will exhibit the same excellence that I experience.

I've been using Dior Capture Totale Le Sérum for a while now, and I have mixed but mostly positive feelings about it. The texture is lightweight and silky, absorbing quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy residue. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup, which is a big plus for daily use. One of the standout features is the hydration and plumping effect—my skin looks smoother and more radiant after application. Over time, I've noticed a subtle improvement in firmness and elasticity, though I wouldn't call it a miracle worker for deep wrinkles or sagging. The formula is packed with Dior's patented longoza extract, which is supposed to boost skin regeneration, and while my skin feels more supple, the results aren't dramatically different from other high-end serums I've tried. The fragrance is light and floral, typical of Dior skincare, which might be a dealbreaker if you have sensitive skin or prefer fragrance-free products. It's not overpowering, but it is noticeable.

This product came to me when I turned 40. And I'm liking it. It leaves my skin very hydrated. But it doesn't leave the face greasy. I've been using it for a few days and I've been really enjoying this product

avis.titre: Possibly too harsh for the winter
avis.texte: I liked the texture, the fact there was no scent, and the packaging. I've been using it for the last couple weeks but a few days ago during a cold snap I woke up with very angry and inflamed skin. It was so bad it looked like I had two black eyes. This has never happened to me before, and this is the only change I've made in my routine so it might be too harsh to use in the winter.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. First off the packaging on this is stunning! It comes in a hygienic pump style, that keeps the product protected from air and light. The product itself feels nice on the skin, it isn't heavy or thick and absorbs well into the skin. There is a scent but I don't find it overpowering. As for the effectiveness, I have noticed my skin looks a bit more bright, as for the fine lines, they look somewhat the same.

I received Dior Capture Le Serum as well as moisturizer! I was excited to try the combination together as the instructions said it works best together. The positives is that it moisturized very well, it didn't have any significant scent and no bad scent. It was an easy application, great packaging and even a little spoon for the moisturizer. The negative is that aside from staying moisturized I didn't see any difference in my face. The most negative is that after a few hours, the product peeled from my face, so if I rub my face, residue wads up and I have residue on my face and hands. There's always a possibility that this isn't a concern for everyone or it might not happen for everyone. For reference, I have combination/dry skin.
So far it's good. Curious to see how it works for a longer period of time. Nice scent and feels moisturizing on the skin. Do feel some tightness but not overally tight. Received for free.

I received this product for free in exchange for my review. I live in a dry climate and this serum has been very hydrating. The consistency is pretty thin, so I typically one need about one pump to cover my face and neck. I haven't noticed a huge difference in the appearance of my skin in the few weeks I have used it, but it definitely feels more hydrated. However, it does have a strong scent!

After using this serum for a very short period, the lines on my forehead and between my eyebrows have diminished dramatically. The serum is moisturizing and pleasantly scented. It goes on glossy, but dries clear once absorbed. Be sure to use completely dry fingers, because any moisture makes rubbing in more difficult. I received this product for free.

What beautiful packaging and an amazing scent that is so light and fresh! From the very first application, the texture of this serum is absolutely divine! So silky smooth, yet it absorbs quickly without any residue. After a week of consistent use, I've noticed a remarkable difference in my skin's firmness and plumpness. My complexion looks noticeably brighter, more radiant, and full of life. A little pump of product goes a long way, especially if you have oilier skin. One of the most impressive benefits is waking up with a visibly more luminous and glowing complexion that lasts all day, even under makeup. Paired with the cream, which has an incredibly lightweight and hydrating texture, my skin feels instantly comforted. The finish is beautifully dewy without being greasy, making it perfect for both day and night use. This serum and cream combination is an excellent choice for those who have aging skin and want to achieve firmer, more youthful-looking skin. The results speak for themselves—hydrated, glowing, and revitalized skin that looks as good as it feels. Highly recommend!

Dior Capture Le Serum truly makes a difference! Well I did not notice immediate effects, after a few days I noticed my forehead wrinkles were less pronounced and my crows feet almost disappeared. The smooth texture and barely there scent felt luxurious on my skin. And a little goes a long way!

This Dior Capture serum has been wonderful to use. I have noticed that my skin has felt bouncier since using it and has a nice glow. It does not feel greasy and absorbs into my skin very nicely. The packing feels so luxurious and heavy, probably because it's a very prestige brand. I am very happy I did not get any skin reaction (break outs, redness) from this product and I would definitely repurchase once I run out. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I was really excited to try these products for the Influencer Program. Both products provide good moisture with a fresh smell that is not too fragrant. Made my skin look very dewy. Beautiful packaging. I was not able to give 5 stars because I was not sure of the long term benefits. I have only used for 2 weeks.

The Dior Capture Totale Le Sérum is a game-changer for skincare, delivering powerful anti-aging benefits with a luxurious, lightweight formula. From the first application, I noticed how effortlessly it absorbed into my skin, providing deep hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. Over time, it worked wonders on my complexion, especially by smoothing out the fine lines and wrinkles near my eyes, making them almost disappear. My skin has never looked more radiant—it has a natural, healthy glow that I've never achieved with any other serum. The scent is light and elegant, not too overpowering, making the experience even more enjoyable. The texture is silky and refreshing, and the elegant packaging adds to the overall experience. If you're looking for a serum that truly delivers visible results, this one is worth it.

avis.titre: Firmer skin especially areas around eyes
avis.texte: This Dior Capture serum really show effects on my skin especially areas around my eyes. I have been using this serum every night for about a month and my face skin looks firmer and glossier compared to before, which is a very good sign and good outcome. Wrinkles around eyes are getting less visible. This serum comes with a subtle scent which is very pleasant when wearing it. The milky like texture serum absorb really good without being greasy. And the bottle gives a luxurious experience.

avis.titre: Light weight texture with a nice scent
avis.texte: I'm not a fan of fragrance in skincare but this serum is an exception. The scent is light and brings a luxury feeling when I apply it. Got this serum for free to try out in combo with the Dior cream. It does a good job of moisturizing my skin and is very light weight.

Let me start by saying luxury skincare is expensive and indulgent, is it necessary no, can you find alternatives, probably. If you are looking into a luxury line you probably are not all that concerned with the price vs the experience so understand you are getting luxury at a luxury price but that doesn't mean you have to buy luxury brands to get good skincare. With that said the Dior Capture Ox-C Treatment Le Serum is a really nice product, it's a lightweight serum I can see working on many skin types. I have combo skin and it is light and dries down to a satin matte finish on my skin and seems to play well with my other skincare. This serum is meant to plump skin, help with wrinkles and firming the skin for a more youthful appearance. Compromised of Hyaluronic Acid, collagen building peptides and some proprietary complex's, to facilitate quicker collagen building. I'm not convinced a serum/leave on treatment can build collagen from the outside quickly like they suggest but this serum is nice. Where I think it shines is brightening, evening your skin and giving a nice radiant glow and maybe some minor plumping effects (after longer use). Understanding skincare is not meant to be a miracle worker, I don't think this serum will fill in deeper wrinkles even after long term use but could plump your skin enough for a smoothing effect on some fine lines. Overall it's nice if you're in the market for a luxury Hyaluronic Acid serum that might also give some minor benefits to fine li

avis.titre: I really wanted to love this
avis.texte: First of all I think it's amazing that Dior gave both the serum and the cream to influensters to try. I love the packaging of these products. And I really wanted to love the products but I think I may be a tad allergic. I would put them on every day for a week in the morning before work. I definitely noticed a change in my skin. It was brighter and more hydrated. But by the end of the day my eyes would be burning. The only way I could find relief is if I just washed my face and used eye drops. I tried going a day without these products to see if they were the issue and my eyes didn't burn when I wasn't wearing the product. Maybe a sensitive skin solution is something that Dior can look into next?

avis.titre: Smooth light serum but strong scent
avis.texte: The Dior Capture Le Serum goes on very smooth and feels slightly cooling. The fragrance they use is rather strong in my opinion. I think the serum would have been a lot better without it. Regarding effectiveness, I will have to try it for about a month or so.

avis.titre: Smooth light serum but strong scent
avis.texte: The Dior Capture Le Serum goes on very smooth and feels slightly cooling. The fragrance they use is rather strong in my opinion. I think the serum would have been a lot better without it. Regarding effectiveness, I will have to try it for about a month or so.

I received this free for review. This serum is really nice. It's lightweight and has no greasy feel. It sinks into the skin quickly and leaves you feeling moisturized. The only negatives are the strong scent and that it contains Lily extract, which is toxic to cats.

My skin has not looked this healthy, glowing or young in a long time. The scent is subtle, the bottle is beautiful it has weight to it and its all silver. It is smooth and absorbs very quickly without leaving your skin sticky or tacky. I love it

I've try this at night the first time with the cream and I have notice in the morning my skin was glowing! Idk if this is a effect but I really like that my skin looks healthy and glowy , This is a totally great serum with the light scent. The packaging is so beautiful and luxurious....I have to give it more chances to see the results

avis.titre: Dior Capture Le Serum Night and Day for skin firmness
avis.texte: I received the newly designed Dior Capture Le Serum night and day products to try for free. Did the new design improve the original recipe? I believe it did. It is the same signature scent but now in a luxurious chrome glass bottle. Somewhat puzzled why Dior uses silver when the name is of French origin meaning golden. Unless it is because Dior prefers gray tones and silver hints at that color range. Regardless the non tacky readily absorbent serum is dispensed through a pump for nighttime application. The day cream comes with a tiny spoon and is thicker in texture for use on the neck and face. I did not experience any break out or redness of my combination skin nor experience any excessive dryness. It has a cooling effect on my face and does seem to smooth my fine lines so they are less noticeable. Time will tell if the OX-C technology is effective compared to other retinal serums for wrinkle correcting and firming results. I love the scent, the chic stunning bottle and jar, and the results on my skin to date.

The serum is nice and lightweight but I don't think I can get over the strong fragrance to use it. It absorbs but I can still tell it's there. I don't notice a difference in my skin but I wouldn't expect to in less than a few months. I like the packaging is an easy to use pump that keeps the product in a dark environment and clean, though it does make it hard to tell when you're running out. Overall I'd say you need to smell the product before you commit to it.

Dior OX-C treatment delivers a beautiful, silky, and weightless serum that quickly fills in fine lines and smooths wrinkles. The serum dispenses easily, (I use 2 pumps for face and neck), and I appreciate that the product is kept in airtight packaging in order to protect the integrity of the product. I've been using this serum for 2 weeks now and have noticed an increase in hydration where my dry spots used to be, as well as a reduction in redness and a dewier, youthful, more even look to my skin. I'm approaching 40 in a few years and am impressed with the innovative ingredients and oxygen transport technology that makes the anti aging ingredients more effective than other brands. The serum has a gorgeous signature scent that smells luxurious, is not overpowering, and does not irritate my skin. I've been using the serum along with the OX-C day cream for maximum benefits. The application of both products feels like I'm treating myself to a facial. I'd highly recommend this innovative and effective serum! This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This serum is by far the best serum for anti-aging. I have noticed visible improvements in skin firmness, texture, and radiance after several uses. The serum's ingredients work together to reverse signs of aging, resulting in smoother and more resilient skin. I also noticed the skin texture has smoothened. The serum is lightweight in texture, which makes it easier for skin to absorb with no wait time. I have also noticed reduction in fine lines and an overall healthier and moisturized complexion.

Gifted by Dior. My skin is dry with the first signs of aging. I've been using this serum twice per day together with a cream from the same line for a few weeks now, and I've definitely noticed a difference: my skin is well-hydrated, smooth, plump, and supple. It makes my face radiant and glowy while helping to firm the skin and reduce fine lines and wrinkles. The serum is very lightweight and fast-absorbing, and it feels extremely comfortable on the skin, leaving it deeply hydrated and silky soft. It is not greasy, sticky, or tacky, and it doesn't pill under makeup. I appreciate that the serum is very gentle—even though my skin is very sensitive, I haven't experienced any irritation. The whole experience is luxurious, from the texture to the bottle. It's such a pleasure to use this serum, and it also looks beautiful on my vanity. A truly high-end product.

Wow! I am absolutely loving both serum and cream. The serum has such a pretty smell as well which makes it feel even even more luxurious in my opinion. so far I've really been enjoying the way it feels on my skin. My skin feels clean and smooth I've been using consistently for over a week now and do feel I am noticing positive changes already and really looking forward to seeing the overall effect of this product with continued use. I did recieve this for my HONEST review and I do truly enjoy this product.

Serum Was so excited to have those to try. Both serum and cream have the rich creamy texture with light scent. After using the serum and cream for a week, I can feel the difference of my skin already. My skin feeling softer and hydrated than before. It is reducing pores on my nose and blurred out my eye wrinkles. CREAM The cream is soft l, silky smooth but not greasy at all. Light fragrance makes us feel comfortable when using it. Skin had been improved from little dry to moisture and soft. Love these products and I will continue use them from now on.

Dior has done it again! This serum is amazing. First use my skin immediately felt beautiful and replenished. Dullness went away and after using it for a few days I could already see my skin firming up. Also a plus- a little bit goes a long way! It does have a scent but it's beautiful and luxurious. I recommend 100% and have added this to my routine. (I received this free from influencer in exchange for an honest review. It's amazing).

I've been using Dior Capture Totale Le Sérum for a week now, and so far, I'm really enjoying it. The texture is lovely—like a creamy serum that's light but not runny, making it easy to apply without dripping everywhere. I like to dispense it onto the back of my hand, dab it around my face, and then smooth it in for even coverage. The scent is fresh and high-quality without being overpowering, and my skin feels great immediately after application—hydrated and smooth. I follow it with the moisturizer from the same line, and they work well together. The packaging is also worth mentioning—the bottle looks beautiful and feels luxurious, and it's easy to use. The pump dispenses just the right amount of product without any mess. After a week, I've noticed slight improvement around the corners of my eyes and the bridge of my nose. It's too soon to tell if it will make a difference on my forehead or neck, but I'm hopeful. Overall, it feels like a luxurious and effective addition to my routine. I'll continue using it and see how it performs over time!

The serum absorbs very well. My face looks more youthful and feels firmer.I've been using this morning and evening. This is a totally great serum with the light scent. The packaging is so beautiful and luxurious. I received the product for free in my review.

I was impressed with this product overall! It arrived well-packaged, and the light scent was pleasant without being overpowering. After using it, I noticed an improvement in my skin texture, and my wrinkles appeared minimized.It absorbed well and left my skin feeling smooth and refreshed.

avis.titre: A high-performance serum that actually works!
avis.texte: This Dior Capture high-performance OX-C treatment serum is beautiful. The packaging, the formula, the light scent, honestly the whole thing is perfection. It instantly makes the skin feel smoother and more plump. There is no residue once it's absorbed in, and the serum makes the skin feel silky soft. I can see this helping with small wrinkles. It's definitely a splurge, but it is worth the money, in my opinion.

In 7 days firmer and smoother skin. The packaging was exquisite. No over powering scent very clean smell. Applying the serum was silky and absorped quickly. I was surprised to receive Dior products. These are full size gifts. Thank you Dior for trusting me to review.

I have been using both the Dior Capture Le Serum and Crème for 5 days now. I can't tell if it's my imagination or what, but I think my skin feels so smooth and supple. The top photo is before I started using, and the bottom is after. I see a few subtle changes, and I believe they will be even more significant after a longer time period of using them both. The serum is very lightweight and smooth in my hand. It does not feel heavy on my face. The cream is the exact same, a little bit heavier than the serum, but nothing overwhelming. I have read reviews that the scent is offputting to some, I don't smell anything off-putting. Even my husband could not tell that I was wearing it when I started. I adore these two new products and I will continue to use them to keep my face feeling bright.
Dior Capture Le Serum is an easy to use and effective serum. The scent is pleasant and works really well to help my face look and feel younger. I would highly recommend Dior Capture Le Serum.

Packing is good, smell is good and It already works after the first few days. Absolutely to recommend. Lightweight with light scents. The gel is economical and easy to spread over the skin. Also comfortable as a base for makeup. Anti-aging???? Don't believe it. Good product though.

Dior Capture Totale Le Sérum is a game-changer for my skincare routine. The texture is silky and absorbs beautifully without feeling heavy. After a few weeks, my skin looks visibly smoother, more radiant, and well-hydrated. Fine lines appear softened, and there's a noticeable firmness that gives my complexion a youthful glow. It's definitely a splurge, but the results make it worth every drop!

I love this serum. It give such a smooth feel and make skin texture brighter. I'm using it everyday and seeing great results with firmness and. Love the packaging as well. Overall a great serum and I recommend.

This Dior capture ox-c treatment Le serum for the face and neck has a lot of innovative looking ingredients to improve skin health, firmness and elasticity over time. I haven't had any adverse reactions and my skin does feel and look smoother since starting use. A little bit of this blends out and goes a long way so this will last you a good while. The mirrored chrome packaging is stunning. Gifted by Dior

I received this product for free from @influenster to review, but that will not change my opinion at all. This is the best launch from Dior Skincare that I've ever had the pleasure of trying. The only drawback is it is heavily fragranced, so sensitive skin beware. Makes my skin a lot softer and smoother. I cant wait to see what the results will be like over time.
